newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner's Turner sees Murdoch curtailed.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner's Turner sees Murdoch curtailed.

text.p: Time Warner Inc vice chairman Ted Turner on Thursday kept up his battle with his media arch rival Rupert Murdoch, saying the head of News Corp Ltd will eventually see his efforts to expand his media empire curtailed.
"He just thinks he's so powerful he can do anything he wants to," Turner told the Western Show, a key cable television industry trade show.
Turner's remarks were in answer to a question about Murdoch and his recent launch of an all-news cable channel, which competes with Time Warner's Cable News Network.
Specifically, Turner was asked about Murdoch's contact with New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani over channel space for Murdoch's news channel on local Time Warner cable systems.
Murdoch's efforts have caused a politcal storm in New York City.
